title: Avoiding stabilization terms in virtual elements for eigenvalue problems: The Reduced Basis Virtual Element Method
summary: We present the novel Reduced Basis Virtual Element Method (rbVEM) for solving the Laplace eigenvalue problem. This approach is based on the lowest-order virtual element method and exploits the reduced basis technique to obtain an explicit representation of the virtual (non-polynomial) contribution to the discrete space. rbVEM yields a fully conforming discretization of the considered problem, so that stabilization terms are avoided.
